name: UltrawideHUD - 21:9
creator: ishanzke
description:
Brings the League of Legends minimap and HUD back within view on ultrawide monitors. Panels sit at the screen edges by default, which on 21:9 and 32:9 means turning your head to check the map. This moves the minimap, team frames, respawn timers and the score/KDA/timer bar inward to a comfortable distance.

## Features

- Minimap, team frames, respawn timers and the top-right score/KDA/timer bar all pulled inward and aligned to a shared edge
- Minimap position holds at **every setting of the in-game minimap size slider** — change the size mid-game and nothing drifts out of line
- Flipped-minimap layouts supported
- Layout only. No gameplay changes, no new textures, no advantage

## Which build

- **21:9** — 3440×1440, 2560×1080
- **32:9** — 5120×1440

The two are tuned separately and are **not** interchangeable. Install one, not both.




Downloads and setup guide: [ultrawidehud.lol](https://ultrawidehud.lol)
Support and patch notifications: [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/VawhDAAbZC)
